metadata.description: CodeYogi skills for making videos with Claude Code — install only the ones you need

plugins.name: video-pack
plugins.description: The CodeYogi video pack — three skills in one install: create-video (script → Remotion video), elevenlabs-audio (voiceover), translate-video (an existing video in another language). Start here.

plugins.name: create-video
plugins.description: Script to Remotion video, built interactively one dialog line at a time. Asks first whether there is a character, whether it lip-syncs and where the voice comes from — nothing is assumed.

plugins.name: elevenlabs-audio
plugins.description: ElevenLabs voiceover: a whole script into per-line mp3s plus stitched sections, one section, or a single re-take of a flubbed line.

plugins.name: hedra-gulla-video
plugins.description: Green-screen talking-character clips from line audio via Hedra, ready for a chroma-key pipeline.

plugins.name: subtitle-screen
plugins.description: Karaoke subtitle screen from an audio file: each sentence appears whole in grey, then every letter deepens to blue in sync with the voice.

plugins.name: language
plugins.description: Converts text in a file or a selection to another language, asking which language first.
